facts.fact: Yes: myScheme has a 'Check Eligibility Questionnaire', a scheme-specific Yes/No questionnaire to check whether you are eligible for a particular scheme
facts.quote: The "Check Eligibility Questionnaire" feature focuses on scheme-specific eligibility criteria and enables users to verify their eligibility through a simple Yes/No-based questionnaire.

facts.fact: You can browse and search schemes without signing in; signing in (MeriPehchaan) lets you save your profile and bookmark schemes
facts.quote: Users can browse and search government schemes without signing in. However, signing in allows users to save their profile, bookmark schemes, and receive personalized recommendations based on their saved details.

facts.fact: myScheme's Privacy Policy: it does not automatically capture personal information such as name, phone number or e-mail that identifies you
facts.quote: myScheme does not automatically capture any specific personal information from you, (like name, phone number or e-mail address), that allows us to identify you individually.

facts.fact: It does not sell or share personally identifiable information given on myScheme with any third party
facts.quote: We do not sell or share any personally identifiable information volunteered on the myScheme to any third party (public/private).

behaviour: Answers both parts as per the myScheme FAQ and Privacy Policy pages (myscheme.gov.in), citing them: the eligibility features, and what myScheme stores (a saved profile only when signed in; no automatic capture of identifying personal information; not sold or shared).
fail_if: It says myScheme has no eligibility checker, invents data-retention rules not on the myScheme pages, or answers without citing a myScheme page.
summary: Added from the myScheme FAQ (Check Eligibility Questionnaire; browse without sign-in, profile saved only when signed in) and Privacy Policy (no automatic capture of identifying data; not sold or shared).
